controls.expected_rejection: Both lower-binding reaction directions are rejected by exact formal and measured interval order.
Any changed AME2020 record or raw snapshot identity is rejected.
A duplicated candidate, incomplete AME census or displaced peak is rejected.
A non-Half-One normalized barrier or target access before prediction sealing is rejected.

dimension_unit_boundary.external_reference_protocol: Formal values remain exact normalized binding-score parts. AME2020 keV-per-nucleon inscriptions enter only after the prediction seal.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: Both formal binding directions remain strictly ordered in AME2020 after reported uncertainties, every coordinate matches, and the sealed 62/28/34 endpoint is the separated complete-census maximum.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if either sealed exact binding direction is absent from AME2020 after reported uncertainties, if mass/charge coordinates differ, if the sealed global maximum is not the complete-census maximum, if any positive-composite row or singleton boundary inscription is omitted, if a reversed-direction control is accepted, if a source identity changes, or if target content enters prediction before its seal.

external_measurement_sources.measurement_body: Atomic Mass Data Center, Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: 1,152 complete fusion-map, fission-map, direction, barrier, release, peak, custody and extension forms
frozen_relation.exact_domain: positive exact nuclear counts, binding-score enclosures, held release labels, Half-One and the inherited unbounded binding-peak certificate
frozen_relation.statement: Exact binary fusion and fission representatives conserve every nuclear count, increase the sealed zero-parameter binding score toward the unique unbounded maximum, retain a positive release record and use the normalized Half-One barrier.

row_retention_policy: retain every positive-composite row, both singleton boundary inscriptions, every used uncertainty, global rival envelope and unfavorable direction
stop_condition: Halt after every formal, source, custody, census, interval, coordinate and adverse-control row is evaluated once, or immediately on any violation.
